spec:
Found by the Missing lens in the review-lens experiment (2026-11-01). G1016 makes submit and edit refuse checkpoint overrides that are not full 40-hex shas, but two places still show the old `{"commit": "<sha>"}` form:
1. records.py:244, the checkpoint_required refusal hint.
2. MIGRATING.md:26, the record-completion step for `edit`.
Change both to `"<full 40-hex sha>"`, matching the card, CLI_USAGE and the prompts.

Acceptance: a test asserts the checkpoint_required hint says `full 40-hex sha`; the docs test checks MIGRATING.md; no other `"commit": "<sha>"` remains in the engine, references, skills or templates (grep in a test).
title: Say full 40-hex sha everywhere a checkpoint override is shown
